stem.text: The diagram shows how an artificial partially permeable membrane was used to separate a 5% sodium chloride solution and a 10% sodium chloride solution in a beaker. The two sides of the beaker were labelled R and S.

stem.alt: Beaker divided by a dashed partially permeable membrane. Left side labelled R with 5% sodium chloride solution, right side labelled S with 10% sodium chloride solution.

stem.text: Which row correctly describes and explains what will happen in the half of the beaker labelled S?
